about_the_game:
Final Splash is a multiplayer party game where the objective is… to die first! 🦈💥
Play as a whale shark fed up with living in a polluted ocean, and turn its last dive into a hilarious and absurd competition.

🎮 Gameplay

The rules are simple: throw yourself at every danger you can find to end your life before your opponents. Explosive mines, sharp metal scraps, swarms of hungry piranhas, erupting volcanoes… everything in the ocean is out to help you win by losing. Matches are fast, chaotic, and full of absurd twists. A full game lasts about 5 minutes (5 rounds).

🎨 Art Direction

Don’t be fooled by the cute and colorful look: the more you play, the gorier it gets. Your whale shark loses limbs, trails of blood spread through the water, and predators feast on your remains. This clash between a cheerful art style and dark humor makes for a unique experience that’s both funny and deliciously disturbing.

  • The whale shark roams the seas with its mouth wide open. It wouldn’t hurt a muss…el.

  • The HamerHead Shark So clumsy… It’s hard to move around with a head this big!

  • Don’t be fooled by its fearsome predator look — the goblin shark is the friendliest of the four.

  • The tiger shark. A true hunter… Fast, agile, and always ready for a fight.

✦ Key Features

  • A twisted concept: win by losing!

  • Simple but varied mechanics thanks to a wide range of ocean hazards.

  • A cute, toy-like art style that turns grotesque as the game progresses.

  • Quick, dynamic matches – perfect for playing with friends.

  • Handcrafted maps with their own traps and personalities.

  • A splash of chaos and laughter guaranteed in every round.

Dive into the absurd, laugh at your own defeats, and turn the art of dying into a true competition.
